summary: Applied Optoelectronics filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Global Technology, Inc. entered a ten-year Factory Premises Lease Agreement with Ningbo Yiduofu Industrial Co., Ltd. for a roughly 38,312 square-meter building in Ningbo, China, commencing September 16, 2026 and expiring September 15, 2036. Annual rent is RMB 6,896,124, escalating 3% every three years from year three, with a three-month rent-free renovation period, alteration rights, and rights of first refusal to purchase or renew. This is a routine lease and direct financial obligation, not a special situation.
